x-native-projection-rules.semantics: Source payload remains immutable. Exact projections may use only literal identity, one source reference string wrapped as one native reference, or the reviewed [open]/[closed]/[locked] and work-tag adapters. Occurred_at native serialization may normalize equivalent timezone syntax; the original literal remains in the source payload.
x-native-projection-rules.enforcement: Only values unchanged from immutable initial projections are exempt. Explicitly edited fields and every new Close/amendment child remain strict.

x-native-v4.legacy_rows: Every immutable attachment row includes import_id. Payload value_json and projection_json are E1 token-preserving strings. Other listed JSON columns export as JSON values. Initial seed snapshots are native JSON, not source events.
x-native-v4.initialization: New legacy candidates only; no automatic upgrade of existing v1-v3 ledgers.
x-native-v4.integrity: Native histories retain their existing contiguous revisions and approvals. Seeded decisions start at native revision 1, ledger revision 0, with separate immutable source origin. All legacy identity, request, payload and projection hashes are revalidated.
